about: Runs that exist on the run host but are superseded and never read (DECISIONS R1-D1): the v5 test runs of C0, C1 and C2 on 2026-09-07/08, made before the revised design. They are registered with their condition, number of cases and times only. No path is recorded and analysis/r1/registry.py refuses an entry that names a directory or a file, so nothing can load their contents; the revised design re-runs every configuration on test once, after the freeze.

Source of the facts: the stage-0 v5 status check (report T8, section 1.6), made with directory listings and file times only; the directories' contents were never opened. n_cases = number of lines of the run's receipts file (equal to the test split size). started = modification time of the generation directory's config.json (written when the runner starts; an inference), finished = modification time of the run directory. The run host's clock is US Eastern daylight time (UTC-4); both forms are recorded.
Configurations C3L, C3E and C3 had request files generated on 2026-09-07 but were never run on test; they are not runs and are not listed.

common.time_basis: directory and file modification times (stat only); start inferred from the runner's config.json
common.record: stage-0 v5 status report T8 section 1.6; DECISIONS R1-D1; RECORDS R1-R1
common.superseded_by: the R1 stage-2 test runs (every configuration once, after the freeze)
